question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average scenario shift (new minus current allocation %) and average scenario count (0 for investors with no scenario records) of investors.
sql_query:
WITH scen AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift, COUNT(*) s_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(sc.s_shift),2) AS avg_scenario_shift,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sc.s_cnt,0)),2) AS avg_scenario_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id

     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 h.risk_score AS risk_score
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p

question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow, total holding gain (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value) and total scenario allocation shift (sum of new minus current allocation %), with average goal shortfall counting against the score. Over investors that have all 4 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1 (use 1 minus the normalised value for average goal shortfall), and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     hold AS (SELECT o.investor_id, SUM(o.current_value-o.cost) h_gain FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o WHERE o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     goals AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) g_short FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 ho.h_gain AS holding_gain,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 g.g_short AS goal_shortfall
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND ho.h_gain IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL AND g.g_short IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(holding_gain) mn_1, MAX(holding_gain) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2, MIN(goal_shortfall) mn_3, MAX(goal_shortfall) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (holding_gain-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (1-(goal_shortfall-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0)))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.holding_gain,2) AS holding_gain,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift,
       ROUND(per.goal_shortfall,2) AS goal_shortfall
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,

                 h.risk_score AS risk_score

              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL AND h.risk_score IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(sector_investment) mn_1, MAX(sector_investment) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2, MIN(risk_score) mn_3, MAX(risk_score) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (sector_investment-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (risk_score-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.sector_investment,2) AS sector_investment,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift,
       ROUND(per.risk_score,2) AS risk_score
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: Among Conservative investors who have at least one underfunded goal (shortfall > 0), which 10 have the highest net cash flow overall?
